utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, it’s still on for Saturday. I’m checking the front steps for the list and still need a few helpers.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it — I’ll sort the tools and keep an eye out for what’s still missing. If you find the list, send it my way and I’ll help round up a few more helpers.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Vik — I’ll check the front steps and send the list over if I find it. A few more helpers would be great.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yep, it’s this Sunday at the community center now — I’ll keep spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it, thanks for the update — I’ll spread the word while I’m out too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate that. The more folks who know it’s Sunday at the community center, the better!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Gus — if you still have any extra screwdrivers or a hammer, those would be really helpful for the repair drive Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Cleo — I’ll look for extra screwdrivers and a hammer and bring them by for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Gus — that would be a huge help. See you Sunday at the community center!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Of course — it’s this Saturday on the front porch. I’ll check the exact time and let you know so we’ve both got it right.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Hana — that sounds right. Just let me know the time when you check, and I’ll be ready.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll confirm the time and send it over soon, Oren.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yep, still this Saturday at the front porch. I’ll bring a few tools and can help set up around 6 if that still works.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That still works perfectly, Noah—thank you for helping set up around 6. I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, I’ll see you around 6 on Saturday at the front porch with a few tools.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: It’s this Saturday on the front porch, and I still need a couple helpers to sort donations. If you can be there around 10, that would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Eli — I can help sort donations around 10. I’ll just need the exact drop-off spot so I can keep things organized.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great—please bring them to the front porch by the steps. Thanks for helping sort at 10; that’ll really keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still on for Saturday at the front porch, right?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I haven’t heard any update yet, but I’m still keeping an ear out for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, thanks — so it’s still planned for Saturday at the front porch unless you hear otherwise, right?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’ve got the hammer and screwdriver and I’ll bring them by the front porch soon.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, thanks, Bo — just bring them to the front porch when you can, and I could still use an extra pair of hands Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help out Saturday too — I’ll swing by the front porch with the tools and lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Mina — please tell folks the repair drive is this Saturday on the front porch, and they can bring any small fix-it items they need help with.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll tell people this Saturday at the front porch, and to bring any small fix-it items they need help with.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Mina — I really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I’m hearing it’s shaping up nicely already. If you want to help out this Saturday, I could still use a few extra hands at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. I can help at the front porch this Saturday, even if only for a little while.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’s wonderful, Uli—every bit helps. I’ll put you down for Saturday at the front porch, and I’ll let you know if I hear of anything else we need.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Rey — I really appreciate it. If you can also bring a screwdriver and a drill, that would help a lot, and I’ll let you know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can bring a screwdriver and a drill on Sunday. Let me know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Rey — that’s perfect. I’ll keep you posted if we need anything else before Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Mostly the setup and a few helpers for Saturday at the front porch. I can work around pickup times, so what part can you take on?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help with setup at the front porch and keep track of what’s still needed for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thank you—setup at the front porch is perfect. I’ll send you the short list after school pickup so we can fill in the last helpers.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Bo—that’d be great. If you could bring any tools or spare parts to the front porch on Saturday, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll bring the hammer and screwdriver to the front porch on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, thanks Bo. I’ve got you down for the hammer and screwdriver at the front porch on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: What still needs fixing for the repair drive? I can bring the screws by and help out too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rey — I’m still waiting on the latest list, but I do know we need helpers and whatever supplies folks can spare. If you bring the screws by, that would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I’ll bring the screws by and help where I can. Just let me know when the latest list comes in.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I still need a couple of helpers for Saturday, plus anyone who can bring a table or extra tape. Could you ask around and let me know who’s available?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Actually, it’s moved to Sunday at the community center, and I still need a few more tools and screws. I’ll ask around for helpers and let you know who’s available.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Cleo — Sunday at the community center works. I’ll ask around for tools and screws, and please let me know who can help.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: It’s at the community center now on Sunday, and I could still use a few more tools and screws if you have any to spare.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is at the community center on Sunday now, right?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, that’s right — Sunday at the community center. And if you’ve got any extra tools or screws, I’d really appreciate them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yep — it’s moved to Sunday at the community center for the repair drive, and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Quinn — Sunday at the community center works. I’d appreciate you spreading the word, and I’ll follow up with the helpers about the change.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep folks posted that it’s Sunday at the community center for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the date, time, and exact location for the repair drive so I can share it correctly?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing—it’s this Saturday at the front porch. I’m still gathering the exact time, but I’ll pass it along as soon as I’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Tess — I’ve got the date and spot now. Just send me the exact time when you know it, and I’ll share the full details.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — I’ll send you the exact drop-off details as soon as I have them. For now, plan on Sunday at the community center, and I’ll make sure you’re updated.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll plan for Sunday at the community center and wait for the drop-off details before I bring anything.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Pia — I’ll be in touch as soon as the drop-off details are confirmed. Thanks for planning ahead!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Ira — appreciate you keeping an ear out. It’s still this Saturday on the front porch, and I can use any extra hands you hear about.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll spread the word and see who can help out Saturday. If anyone’s got tools or free time, I’ll send them your way.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Ira — that’d be a big help. I’m glad you’re sending folks my way for Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—what still needs fixing for the repair drive? Just remind me what you still need from me.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Mostly small stuff — I’m still sorting the list, but a few tools and some hands to help set up would be great. I’ll send the final details as soon as they’re set.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, thanks — send me the final list when you have it, and I can help set up Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It’s this Saturday on the front porch—what still needs fixing before then?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Mostly small stuff still—loose shelves, a wobbly chair, and a couple of hinges. If you can help Saturday, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—what time should I come by on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Jules — please share that it’s this Saturday at my front porch, and I’d love help with small fixes and sorting donations. I’ll be juggling school pickup, so anyone who can come by earlier in the day would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll pass along that it’s this Saturday at your front porch, and that early help with small fixes and sorting donations would be wonderful. I’ll keep an eye out for anyone who can come by earlier in the day.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Jules — I really appreciate it. If anyone has extra tools or boxes for sorting, that would help a lot too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Absolutely — I can check who still needs tools or supplies. Just tell me who’s already covered and I’ll follow up.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. Rey still needs a screwdriver set and a hammer, and Mina could use some nails and a tape measure.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll follow up with Rey and Mina about those items. Thanks, Uli, I’ll keep you posted.
